posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
22f3000179:

abt how much ill be scoring

Your approach does not affect your scoring. You can use any approach as long as it is within the instructions of ques.

For ex: Sometimes in ques they tell not to use ‘some specific thing’ so dont use it in such cases.

Apart from that it does not affect as long as you pass private cases.

posts.name: Joy Jeevan  Ingle
posts.cooked:
what about how much ill be scoring part sir?..
@Gurkirat

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
I am not a sir.

And for your score, you can see what private cases your code has passed. Partial marks are also given if you pass lets say 2/3 private cases.

22f3000179:

i have solved the whole oppe2 but i have got 100/100 in whole section 1, 100/100 is first question of section 2

If you have passed all private cases in all ques of section-1 then just add the marks of individual ques. And same for Ques-1 of section-2.

For those ques in which you didn’t passed private cases, your score will be 0.

If you don’t know which ques consists of how much marks then you should tag TAs/instructors they will let you know.
